caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a traditional wooden hand plane used for woodworking, positioned horizontally and centrally on a plain, off-white background. The hand plane consists of a rectangular block of light brown wood that displays visible wood grain patterns. On the left side of the block, a darker brown, angled metal blade is partially embedded through a slot in the top of the wooden body. Directly in front of the metal blade is a curved wedge, also rendered in a light brown tone, which helps to secure the blade in place. On the right end of the wooden block, there is an upright, curved wooden handle, also light brown in color and showing wood texture, attached to the body. The overall style is realistic, with all components rendered in neutral, earthy hues, and there are no other objects or background details present.
title: Plane
